The tracker’s worker checks each event’s declared constraints before anything else, never on the
caller. An event that breaks one is rejected: never enriched, held by a consent, written to a store
or delivered. Each rejection is reported on

Unread reports merge, one per event, property and keyword, counting the rejections and the range of
times they were tracked, so a broken call site in a loop can’t fill memory.

abstract.text: Stamp every event with its session and with the app, device, system, locale and network it was tracked on.
Keep each record on disk until it is delivered, so a record the app tracked survives the process ending.
Typed analytics events for Swift, delivered in batches to any number of destinations.
An event’s version counts the changes that records stored before them can’t be read through, and only those. A compatible change keeps the version; a breaking one raises it.
Tell the people and services that read your events what each event holds, and hear about a change that would break their data before it ships.

abstract.text: Keep a seeded fraction of the events a tracker tracks, event by event or a whole session at once.
Derive an event’s conformances, name and schema from its struct declaration, and declare the constraints its properties satisfy.
Track screen views, control activations and the app’s lifecycle without a call at each place they happen.
Send events to an analytics vendor Traffluent doesn’t cover yet, from a module of your own, with the same rules as the destinations it ships.
Deliver an event only once the user grants the purpose it is collected for.
